snippet.title: [D1AL-ogue] Official Game Trailer
snippet.description: D1AL-ogue is a story-driven match-3 puzzle game set in 'Chroma City', a cyberpunk metropolis filled with neon lights. Players repair units at the 'D1AL-ogue Repair Clinic' and uncover the city's hidden stories through conversations with them.
